'''Bourom''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], Bourom was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Gravus]].
